scope: Scarlet Invocation's owner-approved sound set: sixteen layered CC0 cues (variant A of every audition scene) replace the borrowed Doll beam, chorus and ceremony cues in the Raid's client presentation and the retired 2026-09-18 Scarlet WAVs. Adds Down, revive and Ready cues through Scarlet's own presentation system, fades voices instead of cutting them, and keeps gameplay, timings and protocol unchanged
target_build: 0.3.69 / protocol79 (feat/scarlet-sfx, stacked on feat/scarlet-signature-moves c7111c1 at 0.3.68; client presentation only)
owner_direction: 2026-10-02: the owner listened to the audition page (16 scenes x 3 variants, plus a 128 BPM phrase demo) and chose variant A for every scene ('効果音はAがいいね')

assets.identity: each file's SHA256 equals the auditioned master's in the audition report, and a fresh render from the hashed external recipe reproduced all sixteen byte for byte
assets.format: kept as OGG like the shipped Ebon Manor and Ghost Samurai SoundStyle cues; no conversion or re-encode
assets.retired: Foretell.wav, CrownRupture.wav, SilkCleave.wav, ThornRend.wav and ScarletRelease.wav were referenced by no code (only their attribution, the explicit-output tools/generate_scarlet_sfx.py and a negative test); the new warning/impact/release cues cover their roles, so the files and their records were removed

mapping.ScarletForetell: CrimsonGestureVisuals: every non-crossflow note's warning tick (Born): basic tracking beams, Act II rifts, Act III rakes, Final pairs and the CinderCurtain/ShroudRope/FourHands signature notes
mapping.ScarletImpact: CrimsonGestureVisuals: the same notes' strike tick (Fire)
mapping.ScarletCrossflowCharge: CrimsonGestureVisuals: SideBeams and Final's ClusterVolley warning on beat 4; the swell peaks at 0.9375 s, two beats later
mapping.ScarletCrossflowRelease: CrimsonGestureVisuals: the same notes' Fire on beat 6
mapping.ScarletStackSuccess / ScarletStackFail,: CrimsonChorusVisuals: the replicated verdict (Resolved, at most TailTicks after Fire), chosen by FailedMask
mapping.ScarletActChange: CrimsonVisuals: PhaseStart + ActRelease (113) of Act II, Act III and Final, the downbeat after the old music's last bar (song bar 26, the full stop, for Act II and Final); replaces PhaseRupture there and is new on Final's stop
mapping.ScarletSacrifice: CrimsonVisuals: PhaseStart + FinalRelease - 57 in Final, so the 0.95 s flash lands on FinalRelease with the visual flash, the pre-drop and the existing shake
mapping.ScarletVictory: CrimsonVisuals: the update on which CrimsonAudio reports the score's Victory cut into the song's full stop as audible (mixer.EndAt, chosen as NextBeat of the write head, reached by the playing chunk's middle); without a streaming score, the first grid beat at or after the observed Victory (MusicStart + BeatTick(BeatAtOrAfter)); a pending cut stops being awaited 60 ticks after Victory; replaces RaidVictory
mapping.ScarletDown / ScarletRevive: CrimsonVisuals.Announce: any member's replicated Recovery.Downed turning on / off (not Out) during Countdown or Performance, compared by connection with the previous snapshot
mapping.ScarletReady: CrimsonVisuals.Announce: any member's Ready flag turning on
mapping.removed_without_replacement: the apparition-birth Beams/PortalFire (its shake stays; the act-change hit carries the sound) and Final's absorb Beams/WideCharge at +155 (superseded by the act-change hit on Final's stop and the sacrifice swell)
mapping.unchanged: Doll RaidDesignation (music start, Final start), PhaseRupture (opening summoning gate, victory flash at +92) and RaidDefeat have no approved replacement scene; the reward companion keeps its Doll beam cues

implementation_decisions.ownership: ScarletVoices (one per presentation system) holds every voice with a lease on the game update clock; Fight end or a non-member view releases voices with an 8-tick fade, and only OnWorldUnload/ClearWorld/Unload stop them outright. A phase-epoch change keeps ringing notes
implementation_decisions.leases: each lease is the file length (ceil(seconds x 60)) plus 10 ticks, longer than the fade, so a natural ending is never shortened; this replaces the chorus voices' 100-tick hard stop and the gesture voices' 50/100-tick leases
implementation_decisions.dedupe: gesture sound is keyed by (phrase, tick, cue): notes released on the same tick, such as Final's paired families, share one voice; per-gesture visuals still fire once each
implementation_decisions.gain: one gain (1.0) for the whole set keeps the designed relative levels; SoundStyle volume cannot exceed 1. Effective K-weighted 100 ms peaks (file level plus gain): the loudest new cues (crossflow release, act change, victory) reach -8.1 dB, at least 2 dB under the loudest retired Scarlet uses (StackRelease at .48 -5.8, WideFire at .72 -6.0, ChargeRush at .72 -6.5, PortalFire at .72 -6.7). The repeated notes become quieter than the cues they replace (impact -14.3 vs -6.7, foretell -18.0 vs ChargeLock at .48 -13.8); some moments that used soft Doll cues become louder by design of the set (victory -8.1 vs RaidVictory at .40 -13.1, act change -8.1 vs PhaseRupture at .48 -10.6, Spread success -13.1 vs SpreadDissolve at .48 -16.5, Stack call -14.0 vs StackSummon at .25 -16.4, Spread failure -10.3 vs SpreadExecution at .48 -10.9)
implementation_decisions.pitch: no runtime pitch offset (the Final cluster's -0.12 octave was dropped) so the cues stay in the E-flat family
implementation_decisions.limits: foretell/impact 3 instances, crossflow and chorus cues 2 (ReplaceOldest, above the normal overlap); act change, sacrifice and victory 1, Down/revive 3, Ready 2 (IgnoreNew)
implementation_decisions.playback: non-positional, PlayOnlyIfFocused and StopWhenGamePaused like the replaced cues; systems are client-side autoloads and ScarletVoices.Play returns on Main.dedServ
implementation_decisions.victory_alignment: review fix: the bell no longer recomputes the cut beat from VisualAge. The mixer picks NextBeat(cursor) from a write head 2-3 chunks (about 2.6-3.8 ticks) ahead of the speakers, and in single player one update after the visuals see Victory, so a beat inside that window put the bell one beat before the full stop; CrimsonAudio.VictoryCut now reports Absent/Pending/Heard for the Fight and the bell rings on Heard
